name: Hakuisei Ren'ai Shoukougun
source: The story follows Sawai Kaori who almost died in a traffic accident at the age of 10 but was revived by hospital staff. Ever since then, Kaori became determined to take up ‘nursing’ as her means of saying thanks to the doctors who rescued her.  And so at the age of 21, she begins her journey as a nurse…
translation: 泽井香织十岁时险些死于交通事故，所幸被医院工作人员救活。自那以后，她便决心成为护士，以此向救命的医护人员表达感谢。二十一岁这年，香织终于踏上了护理工作者的道路……
